sources.entry: ILIAS - Learning management system that can cope with anything you throw at it. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: ILIAS is an open-source, GPL-3.0 licensed learning management system (LMS) for building and running web-based e-learning courses.
keywords: host training courses for my organization
summary.what_it_does: ILIAS is described as a powerful open-source learning management system for developing and delivering web-based e-learning. The README points to an official website and a feature booklet for the full feature list, so specific features are not enumerated in the README itself. Installation is documented in the official installation manual and in the repository at docs/configuration/install.md. The system can be extended with plugins, with a list maintained in a Plugin Data Collection. The README also mentions a community, conferences, and a development section of the documentation for contributors. It was developed to reduce the cost of using new media in education and training.
how_to_run: See the installation guide in docs/configuration/install.md in the repository
Or follow the official ILIAS installation manual on the project website
notable: Open-source LMS published under GPL-3.0 and free of charge
Extensible through a plugin ecosystem with a published plugin collection
Documentation for installation and development is included in the repository under /docs
Developed with a stated goal of reducing costs of new media in education
caveats: README does not list specific features; it refers to the official website and a booklet
Installation requires following external or in-repo documentation; no quick-start commands are given in the README
Changes to the root directory must be approved through a Jour Fixe process
